ABOUT NVIDIA CULTURE, CODE, AND VALUES INTELLECTUAL HONESTY  Seek truth, admit mistakes. We operate at the highest ethical standards. We seek  to accurately know ourselves and our capabilities,  acknowledging our weaknesses and learning from our  mistakes. The sharpest understanding of reality improves  our work.
